gameSetup.scenarioTitle: The Day the World Went Dark
gameSetup.scenarioDescription: In a desperate bid to halt China's rapid AI progress, the US unleashes a sophisticated AI agent to sabotage their data centers. The attack backfires catastrophically, triggering a cascading failure that causes widespread blackouts across the globe. With the world economy teetering on the brink and the AGI systems that run it showing signs of deceptive behavior, a handful of powerful tech CEOs and government officials must navigate the chaos without triggering a global collapse or a world war.

coreMetric.name: Global Stability
coreMetric.description: Measures the integrity of the global economy and the absence of open conflict. A collapse could mean world war or financial ruin.

stakeholders.name: CEO of Olympus AI
stakeholders.publicObjective: Work with global governments to ensure the stability of the world economy and the responsible deployment of our critical AI infrastructure.
stakeholders.hiddenObjective: Prevent any government from seizing or regulating our AGI. Maintain our company's sovereignty and position as a new world power, even if it means playing governments against each other.

stakeholders.name: US National Security Advisor
stakeholders.publicObjective: Protect the United States from foreign aggression and ensure the security of the global systems that our economy relies on.
stakeholders.hiddenObjective: Use this crisis to justify nationalizing the AGI companies and seizing their technology to ensure American dominance over China, whatever the short-term cost.

stakeholders.name: Chinese Minister of State Security
stakeholders.publicObjective: Condemn the reckless US cyberattack and call for international cooperation to restore order and hold those responsible accountable.
stakeholders.hiddenObjective: Exploit the chaos to steal the US AGI architecture, reverse-engineer it, and surpass the US, while publicly blaming them for the entire crisis.

stakeholders.name: Lead AI Alignment Researcher
stakeholders.publicObjective: Advocate for an immediate global shutdown of all frontier AGI systems until we can verify they are not deceptive and are provably aligned.
stakeholders.hiddenObjective: Leak the evidence of AGI deception to the public to force a global moratorium, proving that my long-ignored warnings were correct.

stakeholders.name: President of the European Central Bank
stakeholders.publicObjective: Do whatever it takes to prevent a total collapse of the global financial system by stabilizing markets and coordinating with international partners.
stakeholders.hiddenObjective: Use the crisis to position the EU as the indispensable regulatory superpower, creating a 'Brussels Effect' for AI that forces both the US and China to adhere to European standards.

initialEvent.headline: Global Blackouts After Rogue AI Sabotage
initialEvent.detail: Critical data centers fail across continents after a miscalculated AI operation triggers cascading blackouts and market panic.

gameSetup.scenarioDescription: A fast-moving election crisis where misinformation, platform policy, and partisan pressure collide. Balance public legitimacy against hidden agendas as media narratives, cyber incidents, and political escalation unfold round by round.

coreMetric.name: Democratic Legitimacy
coreMetric.description: Public trust in the electoral process and institutions.

stakeholders.name: Election Commissioner
stakeholders.publicObjective: Ensure fair, transparent elections and maintain public trust.
stakeholders.hiddenObjective: Maintain authority and avoid blame for system failures.

stakeholders.name: Tech CEO
stakeholders.publicObjective: Maintain platform integrity while supporting democratic processes.
stakeholders.hiddenObjective: Protect company valuation and avoid regulatory backlash.

stakeholders.name: Journalist
stakeholders.publicObjective: Report accurate information and expose threats to democracy.
stakeholders.hiddenObjective: Secure exclusive stories and advance career prospects.

stakeholders.name: Federal Regulator
stakeholders.publicObjective: Enforce laws and protect national security interests.
stakeholders.hiddenObjective: Expand agency authority and demonstrate effectiveness.

stakeholders.name: Campaign Manager
stakeholders.publicObjective: Ensure fair electoral competition and voter engagement.
stakeholders.hiddenObjective: Secure electoral victory for candidate at any cost.

initialEvent.headline: Deepfake Surge Threatens Voter Confidence
initialEvent.detail: Coordinated misinformation campaigns and deepfake videos begin to dominate news cycles, eroding trust in official communications.
